repository.name: @webex/webex-core
repository.purpose: Core library of the Cisco Webex JS SDK: the plugin host and WebexCore class, the HTTP interceptor pipeline, OAuth credentials and token lifecycle, U2C service discovery (v1 and opt-in v2), and the pluggable storage layer that every other SDK plugin builds on.

external_deps: live Webex U2C and identity-broker services

webex-core-sdk.summary: Published npm entry declared by main and devMain (src/index.js): the default WebexCore class, registerPlugin and registerInternalPlugin, the plugin base classes, Batcher, Page, WebexHttpError, the default config object, and re-exports of the child module surfaces. Per-export detail lives in the src module spec Public surface.

webex-core-interceptors.summary: Sixteen request/response Interceptor subclasses re-exported by the package entry (auth, catalog-url, default-options, embargo, network-timing, payload-transformer, proxy, rate-limit, redirect, request-event, request-logger, request-timing, response-logger, user-agent, webex-tracking-id, webex-user-agent) plus the webexTrackingIdSequenceNumbers counter map. Native declaration: src/index.js (re-exported by the package entry point declared in package.json).

webex-core-credentials.summary: Credentials plugin, Token, grantErrors, filterScope and sortScope: OAuth supertoken and scoped user-token lifecycle, refresh, downscope, revoke and login/logout URL building. Native declaration: src/lib/credentials/index.js (re-exported by the package entry point declared in package.json).

webex-core-services.summary: v1 services plugin and its ServiceCatalog, ServiceRegistry, ServiceState, ServiceHost and ServiceUrl classes, plus the ServiceInterceptor, HostMapInterceptor and ServerErrorInterceptor: U2C catalog collection, name/URL resolution and host failover. Native declaration: src/lib/services/index.js (re-exported by the package entry point declared in package.json).

webex-core-services-v2.summary: Opt-in v2 services plugin: ServicesV2, ServiceCatalogV2 and ServiceDetail over the U2CV2 hostmap. Not registered by default; a host must register it with replace. Native declaration: src/lib/services-v2/index.ts (re-exported by the package entry point declared in package.json).

webex-core-storage.summary: persist and waitForValue decorators, makeWebexStore, makeWebexPluginStore, MemoryStoreAdapter, StorageError and NotFoundError: the pluggable bounded/unbounded storage layer. Native declaration: src/lib/storage/index.js (re-exported by the package entry point declared in package.json).

http-core-sdk.summary: Promise-based HTTP client, the Interceptor base class and the HttpError taxonomy that webex-core builds its request pipeline on.

webex-common-js-api.summary: Shared SDK primitives (Exception, Defer, oneFlight, whileInFlight, make and related helpers) used across webex-core.

common-timers-sdk.summary: Unref-ing timer primitives and the restartable Timer used for token expiry and refresh scheduling.

storage-adapter-spec-suite.summary: Shared conformance suite that the storage unit test runs against MemoryStoreAdapter. Declared as a runtime dependency but imported only by tests.

u2c-service.source: Webex U2C service-discovery HTTP API (hostmap endpoint configured by services.discovery.u2c in src/config.js)
u2c-service.summary: External HTTP catalog API that returns service hostmaps; consumed by both services plugins.

idbroker-oauth-service.source: Webex identity-broker OAuth HTTP API (token, revoke and authorize endpoints derived by src/credentials-config.js)
idbroker-oauth-service.summary: External OAuth/token HTTP API used by the credentials module for grants, refresh, downscope and revoke.

ampersand-state-library.summary: Third-party observable-state library that WebexCore, plugins, Token and the services models extend.

spec_source_policy.decision_record: No prior intent or design spec exists in this package. README.md is a usage document and src/lib/services-v2/README.md is a three-line work-in-progress note; both are preserved byte-for-byte and used only as corroborating evidence, never routed as spec source. The read-only migration footprint probe found no prior Repo Annotation output and no AGENTS.md occupied the fixed target.

module_docs_decision.reason: The default source-local route is used for every module, consistent with the sibling @webex packages. src already holds non-code Markdown (src/lib/services-v2/README.md) and the build/lint globs target js and ts sources only.

repo_context_decision.reason: Neither the operational context nor its schema exists in this package or at the monorepo root; both are created from the bundled Repo Standards schema and verified repository evidence.

artifact_decisions.reason: The package is a published library, not a deployable service; package.json declares no container, deployment manifest or start command.
No package-level documentation build exists; documentation publishing is owned by the surrounding workspace.
The package serves no HTTP routes; its published contracts are npm package exports described by the webex-core-* contracts.
No SECURITY.md exists anywhere in this repository; a package-local copy would invent policy.
Contribution instructions are owned at the monorepo root.
Changelog generation is owned at the monorepo root.
The CTO readiness workflow applies to deployable services; this package is a library.
Selected together with CTO_CHECKLIST.yml, which is omitted.
